definitions.explanation: A pungent green condiment made from the grated rhizome of the wasabi plant, commonly served with sushi and sashimi.

examples.japanese: {刺身|さしみ}に{山葵|わさび}をつけて{食|た}べる。
{山葵|わさび}が{効|き}きすぎて{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: The wasabi was too strong and I got teary-eyed.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}{山葵|わさび}は{値段|ねだん}が{高|たか}い。

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
- Most "wasabi" served in restaurants outside Japan (and even in many Japanese restaurants) is actually colored horseradish ({西洋|せいよう}わさび).
- {本|ほん}わさび refers to authentic wasabi from the wasabi plant.
- Fresh wasabi is grated on a {鮫皮|さめかわ}おろし (sharkskin grater).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山葵|わさび}をつける (to add wasabi)
- {山葵|わさび}が{効|き}く (wasabi is hot/strong)
- {山葵|わさび}{抜|ぬ}き (without wasabi)
- {練|ね}り{山葵|わさび} (wasabi paste)
